title: Learning the Autoregressive: Direct Score-Difference Estimation with Amortized Future Credit for Video Distillation
title_zh: 学习自回归：用于视频蒸馏的直接分数差估计与摊销未来信用

paragraphs.en: Few-step distillation for autoregressive (AR) video generation commonly first initializes an AR student and then refines it with distribution matching distillation (DMD). This refinement process faces two challenges. First, although initialization already yields a reasonably capable student, DMD obtains the refinement direction indirectly by estimating the full student score before forming the teacher–student correction. Second, detached-history training prevents the generator from assigning credit to a current chunk for its influence on subsequent chunks. We introduce Leta, a few-step distillation framework that addresses these challenges with ScoreDelta and FutureCredit . ScoreDelta directly estimates the teacher–student correction from denoising residuals, while FutureCredit learns an auxiliary cross-chunk update signal from vector–Jacobian products (VJPs) of next-chunk teacher residuals. Leta combines these signals into a joint teacher-guided update field in a single forward pass during generator updates. Teacher evaluations and credit VJPs are used only for estimator training. For ScoreDelta , we establish population equivalence to score-difference estimation and a conditional approximation advantage under limited capacity in a fixed-feature linear model. In our controlled experiments, Leta improves over DMD by 0.9 0.9 points on VBench and 0.66 0.66 on VideoAlign. This advantage persists at a higher generator update frequency (a generator-to-estimator update ratio of G : E = 1 : 1 G{:}E=1{:}1 ), where Leta improves over DMD by 1.6 1.6 on VBench and 0.35 0.35 on VideoAlign. Project page: https://scdzx.github.io/Leta/ .

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video generation have enabled increasingly realistic and temporally coherent synthesis, yet efficient generation remains a key challenge [ 1 , 25 , 4 , 13 , 31 , 40 , 3 , 42 , 41 , 33 , 12 , 9 ] . Autoregressive (AR) models support incremental video synthesis by generating successive chunks conditioned on previously generated content [ 32 , 34 , 29 ] . However, generating each chunk can still require many denoising steps, motivating the development of few-step AR generators [ 5 , 23 , 22 , 30 ] . A common pipeline first initializes such generators and then refines them through on-policy distribution matching distillation (DMD), using the student’s own generated rollouts so that the conditioning history matches that encountered at inference [ 11 , 43 ] . DMD guides the student with a teacher–student score difference, providing a correction signal for distribution matching. In this setting, two challenges remain: accurately estimating this correction signal, and accounting for how each generated chunk influences subsequent generation. We propose Leta to address both challenges by directly learning the local teacher–student residual and amortizing teacher-guided credit across chunks. Figure 1 shows a qualitative example.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成的最新进展已经能够实现越来越逼真且时间上一致的合成，但高效生成仍然是一个关键挑战 [ 1 , 25 , 4 , 13 , 31 , 40 , 3 , 42 , 41 , 33 , 12 , 9 ] 。 自回归（AR）模型通过在先前生成内容的条件下生成连续的视频片段，支持增量式视频合成 [ 32 , 34 , 29 ] 。 然而，生成每个片段仍可能需要许多去噪步骤，这促使了少步 AR 生成器的发展 [ 5 , 23 , 22 , 30 ] 。 一种常见的流程是先初始化此类生成器，然后通过在线策略分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）对其进行精炼，利用学生模型自身生成的展开内容，使条件历史与推理时遇到的历史相匹配 [ 11 , 43 ] 。 DMD 利用教师与学生之间的分数差来指导学生模型，为分布匹配提供纠正信号。 在这一设定下，仍存在两个挑战：如何准确估计这一纠正信号，以及如何考虑每个生成片段对后续生成的影响。 我们提出 Leta，通过直接学习局部教师-学生残差并在各片段间摊销教师引导的信用分配，来同时应对这两个挑战。 图 1 展示了一个定性示例。

paragraphs.en: The first challenge is particularly important in this initialized regime. Few-step AR students are typically initialized by distilling teacher denoising trajectories: ODE distillation follows the teacher’s probability-flow trajectory, while Causal Forcing uses an AR teacher and Causal Forcing++ adopts consistency distillation (CD) for a stronger initialization [ 38 , 11 , 45 , 26 , 43 ] . To measure how much refinement remains, Figure 2 applies the same teacher refinement to ODE- and CD-initialized samples, using teacher self-refinement as a reference, and compares their before–after high-frequency (HF) cosine similarity. CD samples change less under refinement, indicating a stronger starting point and a smaller residual gap. Yet DMD still estimates the full student score, so estimation errors may mask the subtle correction needed for further refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个挑战在这个初始化状态中尤为重要。 少步自回归（AR）学生模型通常通过蒸馏教师去噪轨迹来初始化：ODE 蒸馏遵循教师的概率流轨迹，而 Causal Forcing 使用 AR 教师，Causal Forcing++ 则采用一致性蒸馏（CD）以获得更强的初始化 [38, 11, 45, 26, 43]。 为了衡量还剩多少精炼工作，图 2 对 ODE 初始化和 CD 初始化的样本应用相同的教师精炼，并以教师自精炼作为参照，比较它们精炼前后高频（HF）余弦相似度。 CD 样本在精炼下变化较小，表明其起点更强、残余差距更小。 然而 DMD 仍估计完整的学生分数，估计误差可能掩盖进一步精炼所需的细微校正。

paragraphs.en: To focus learning on the subtle corrections left after initialization, we propose ScoreDelta to estimate the teacher–student residual directly. Figure 3 (left) contrasts this direct gap estimation with estimating the full student score before subtraction. Given a noisy student rollout, the estimator regresses the teacher’s denoised prediction minus the original clean rollout, without separately estimating the full student score. Proposition 1 proves that, for a fixed student distribution and an optimal teacher, the population-optimal residual estimator recovers the same teacher–student score difference used by DMD, up to a known timestep scaling. In a fixed-feature linear setting, Proposition 2 further shows that direct residual estimation can achieve lower approximation error under the same capacity constraint when the residual is simpler to represent.

paragraphs.en: Estimating the score difference is only part of forming an AR generator update. Each generated chunk also becomes an input to later chunks, so changing it affects subsequent generation. Backpropagating through the full rollout incurs a large memory cost, so training typically detaches the generated history. Although DMD’s bidirectional teacher and fake-score model can use future context, their score predictions do not restore these cross-chunk gradient paths in the generator. We introduce FutureCredit to provide teacher-guided auxiliary updates from the next chunk, augmenting the current chunk’s local correction as illustrated conceptually in Figure 3 (right). A Vector–Jacobian Product (VJP) propagates the next chunk’s teacher residual through a replay of the generator’s final denoising step, providing an auxiliary target. We train an estimator to predict the processed target from the noisy rollout, making this guidance available through a forward pass during generator updates.

paragraphs.en: Together, ScoreDelta and FutureCredit form Leta. On few-step text-to-video distillation with Wan [ 28 ] , Leta improves over DMD on VBench [ 14 ] Overall and VideoAlign [ 18 ] visual and motion scores. It also achieves higher visual and motion scores than released RAVEN [ 21 ] and DistillAlign [ 16 ] checkpoints, with competitive VBench performance. The comparisons to the released checkpoints are reference comparisons, since those checkpoints are not retrained under our controlled protocol. Controlled ablations show gains from both components.
paragraphs.zh: ScoreDelta 与 FutureCredit 共同构成 Leta。 在基于 Wan [ 28 ] 的少步文本到视频蒸馏中，Leta 在 VBench [ 14 ] 总分以及 VideoAlign [ 18 ] 视觉与运动评分上均优于 DMD。 它还取得了比已发布的 RAVEN [ 21 ] 与 DistillAlign [ 16 ] 检查点更高的视觉与运动评分，同时 VBench 表现具有竞争力。 与已发布检查点的比较仅为参考性比较，因为这些检查点并非在我们的受控协议下重新训练。 受控消融实验表明两个组件均带来提升。

paragraphs.en: Few-Step Distillation. Few-step distillation reduces the sampling cost of diffusion models [ 17 , 2 , 24 , 7 , 5 ] . Progressive distillation and consistency-based methods further reduce the number of sampling steps for image and video diffusion models [ 23 , 22 , 30 ] . Consistency models learn consistent predictions along probability-flow trajectories [ 26 ] , while DMD and DMD2 train generators through distribution matching using teacher–student score differences [ 37 , 36 ] . rCM combines continuous-time consistency distillation with score regularization [ 44 ] , while AnyFlow uses on-policy flow-map distillation to support flexible sampling budgets [ 8 ] . For AR video generation, Causal Forcing and Causal Forcing++ improve student initialization through causal ODE and consistency distillation [ 26 , 45 , 43 ] . DistillAlign further combines mode-seeking distribution matching with a mode-covering consistency constraint [ 16 ] . Our ScoreDelta focuses on the refinement signal itself, directly learning the teacher–student correction from noisy student rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 少步蒸馏。 少步蒸馏降低了扩散模型的采样成本 [ 17 , 2 , 24 , 7 , 5 ] 。 渐进蒸馏和基于一致性的方法进一步减少了图像和视频扩散模型的采样步数 [ 23 , 22 , 30 ] 。 一致性模型沿概率流轨迹学习一致的预测 [ 26 ] ，而 DMD 和 DMD2 利用教师–学生得分差通过分布匹配来训练生成器 [ 37 , 36 ] 。rCM 将连续时间一致性蒸馏与得分正则化相结合 [ 44 ] ，而 AnyFlow 使用在策略流映射蒸馏来支持灵活的采样预算 [ 8 ] 。 对于自回归视频生成，Causal Forcing 和 Causal Forcing++ 通过因果 ODE 和一致性蒸馏改进学生初始化 [ 26 , 45 , 43 ] 。 DistillAlign 进一步将模式寻求的分布匹配与模式覆盖的一致性约束相结合 [ 16 ] 。 我们的 ScoreDelta 聚焦于精炼信号本身，从带噪学生的 rollout 中直接学习教师–学生的修正量。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive Video Generation. Autoregressive video models generate successive chunks conditioned on previously generated content [ 32 , 34 , 20 , 35 , 4 , 29 , 33 , 12 , 10 , 27 , 39 , 19 ] . CausVid distills a bidirectional diffusion teacher into a few-step causal generator [ 38 ] , while Self Forcing addresses the training–inference mismatch by training on the student’s own generated histories [ 11 ] . RAVEN [ 21 ] and Self Gradient Forcing [ 46 ] further enable future losses to supervise historical context representations. More broadly, synthetic gradients learn update signals to decouple neural-network training [ 15 ] . Our FutureCredit learns auxiliary guidance from next-chunk teacher-residual VJPs, making cross-chunk information available through an estimator forward pass during generator updates with detached history.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频生成。 自回归视频模型在先前已生成内容的条件下逐段生成后续内容 [ 32 , 34 , 20 , 35 , 4 , 29 , 33 , 12 , 10 , 27 , 39 , 19 ] 。 CausVid 将双向扩散教师模型蒸馏为少步因果生成器 [ 38 ] ，而 Self Forcing 通过在智能体自身生成的历史上进行训练来解决训练与推理之间的不一致问题 [ 11 ] 。 RAVEN [ 21 ] 和 Self Gradient Forcing [ 46 ] 进一步使未来损失能够监督历史上下文表示。 更广泛地说，合成梯度通过学习更新信号来解耦神经网络的训练 [ 15 ] 。 我们的 FutureCredit 从下一段教师残差的 VJP 中学习辅助引导，使跨段信息在生成器更新时（历史被截断梯度）能够通过估计器的一次前向传播获得。

paragraphs.en: We perform final-stage on-policy few-step distillation using the CD-initialized causal Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B model provided by Causal Forcing++ [ 43 ] . Our controlled training comparisons include DMD, ScoreDelta , and Leta. Unless otherwise specified, these runs alternate one generator update with four estimator updates ( G : E = 1 : 4 G:E=1:4 ), and use a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} for the generator and 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} for the estimator, with a batch size of 16 on 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. Following the Self-Forcing setting [ 11 ] , each rollout consists of N = 7 N{=}7 chunks of 3 latent frames each (21 latent frames in total), with four denoising steps for each generated chunk; all other generation, rollout, and training-data details follow the public Self-Forcing codebase. Unless otherwise specified, the auxiliary estimator is initialized from the bidirectional multi-step Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B model [ 28 ] ; when a teacher score or clean prediction is required, the same pretrained model is kept frozen and used as the teacher. Our standard 1:4 runs use 1,200 total optimizer updates; the 1:1 ablation uses 600 total updates. Our trained variants share the same causal initialization, training data, self-forcing rollout procedure, and sampling-step configuration. RAVEN [ 21 ] and DistillAlign [ 16 ] are evaluated using their publicly released checkpoints.

paragraphs.en: We presented Leta, a distillation framework for few-step AR video generation that combines ScoreDelta ’s direct local correction with FutureCredit ’s cross-chunk credit in a shared estimator. Experiments show improved visual and motion quality over DMD across evaluated settings. Nevertheless, current AR video generation lacks explicit planning for future motion and scene evolution, which may lead to unnatural dynamics in complex scenes and error accumulation over long horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Leta，一个面向少步自回归视频生成的蒸馏框架，它在共享估计器中结合了 ScoreDelta 的直接局部校正与 FutureCredit 的跨片段信用分配。 实验表明，在所评估的设置下，其视觉与运动质量均优于 DMD。 然而，当前的自回归视频生成缺乏对未来运动与场景演化的显式规划，这可能导致复杂场景中的不自然动态以及长时程上的误差累积。
